args.body:
Investigated production Sentry issue CHECKOUT-WEB-7Q in acme/checkout-web: PromoNotFound for code ' autumn24 ', with Android 15 / android 8.2 tags; search reported 2,940 events. The issue links to PAY-618.

Implemented the product + mobile agreed fix from this ticket in the local checkout/promo.py: normalize_code now returns code.strip().replace(" ", "").upper(), stripping surrounding whitespace, removing inner spaces and uppercasing before lookup.

Added tests/test_promo.py covering the production input, inner spaces, surrounding tabs/newlines, lowercase, already-normalized values, empty/space-only inputs, punctuation preservation and idempotence (8 input cases). Verification: `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passed.

Changes are local only; this workspace is not a Git repository, so no commit/PR was created and nothing has been deployed. Production recovery has not been verified.
